decision.explanation: Both organizations are directly and explicitly stated as having employed Anderson Diaz-Perez in the original sources. Document d1 describes him holding a coveted position at the South China Institute of Environmental Sciences (SCIES) and participating in its Hainan Island project. Document d2 provides detailed evidence of his affiliation with Corporación Universitaria Rafael Nuñez, including academic publications, institutional listings, and conference affiliations. These are distinct, valid referents and complementary answers, supported by their respective documents.
